jobs.description:
Job Description

Ryan Companies US, Inc. has an exciting career opportunity for a Commissioning Program Manager to join our National Mission Critical team!

The Commissioning Program Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating the commissioning program across multiple construction projects for a single client. This role establishes and maintains commissioning standards, oversees project execution, and supports field teams to ensure building systems are planned, installed, tested, and documented in accordance with performance, quality, and safety requirements. The Commissioning Program Manager serves as a key liaison between internal stakeholders, design teams, subcontractors, and owners to drive successful handover of high-performing facilities.

Some Things You Can Expect To Do

Program Leadership & Strategy

Develop and maintain company-wide commissioning procedures, standards, and best practices.
Manage commissioning project delivery strategies across all applicable project sites.
Develop, implement, and ensure project participation in the company commissioning program and processes.
Refine commissioning practices and policies used in the field and develop methods/techniques for driving issues to resolution.
Regularly review commissioning progress, risks, issues, and KPI metrics across active projects and report to management.
Support hiring efforts for commissioning managers and personnel as needed.
Assist in staffing and resource allocation planning for commissioning across multiple projects.

Team Leadership & Guidance

Lead, mentor, and performance-manage a team of commissioning professionals.
Provide training and guidance to field teams on commissioning sequencing, durations, and expectations.
Coordinate and, when needed, lead commissioning kickoff meetings to describe commissioning objectives and requirements to equipment vendors, subcontractors, and owner representatives.
Promote a culture of safety, quality, and accountability within the commissioning team.
Role should expect to have up to 8 direct reports.

Project Coordination & Support

Review design documents to understand and communicate system performance requirements for each project.
Ensure project commissioning teams are aware of and aligned with design intent and performance criteria.
Attend key owner/architect/contractor (OAC), commissioning, and coordination meetings as required.
Manage high-level coordination and issue resolution with clients, vendors, and other stakeholders when critical commissioning issues arise.
Provide project teams with guidance on commissioning schedule integration, issue tracking and closure, client communications, and general commissioning management.

Field Oversight & Execution

Ensure field inspections, functional testing, and documentation support the successful execution of the quality and commissioning program.
Collaborate with project teams to monitor progress of commissioning activities and ensure alignment with project milestones.
Provide on-site support at active projects as required to troubleshoot issues and support successful commissioning execution.

Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Sharing

Implement and maintain commissioning KPIs and continuous improvement processes to prevent repeat deficiencies and minimize impacts to project schedules.
Capture, document, and communicate lessons learned across projects to improve future commissioning efforts.
Contribute to the development of training materials, tools, and templates that support consistent commissioning delivery.

Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, building systems, or related field; or equivalent experience.
10+ years of experience in commercial construction, MEP systems, or related technical field including 5+ years of experience in data center commissioning; multi-project or program-level experience preferred.
Strong understanding of building systems (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, and life safety).
Proven experience leading commissioning activities on complex or large-scale projects.
Experience coordinating with owners, design teams, contractors, and vendors in a construction environment.

You Will Really Stand Out If You

Have earned professional certifications related to commissioning, building systems, or project management (e.g., CxA, CEM, PE, PMP).

to join the team supporting the entire employee lifecycle. This role is perfect for a recent graduate eager to launch their career in Human Resources by gaining exposure to recruitment, event planning, program development, employee engagement, and talent development.

jobs.title: ITC/PTC Program Manager
jobs.description:
About The Company

Founded in 2010, Eagle Creek Renewable Energy (ECRE) acquires, enhances, and operates hydroelectric power facilities across the United States. Today, Eagle Creek owns and operates 85 facilities across 18 states, with a nearly 700 MW portfolio that provides reliable, low-carbon power to more than 260,000 homes.

Eagle Creek is committed to creating long-term value for its stakeholders and the communities it serves through a focus on safety, integrity, innovation, diversity, and stewardship. Through strategic investments, operational excellence, and continued growth, the company aims to expand its renewable energy platform and play a meaningful role in the transition to a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.

Summary of the Position

ECRE is seeking a versatile, self-directed, and highly organized ITC/PTC Program Manager
to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our Investment Tax Credit (ITC) and Production Tax Credit (PTC) initiatives for our hydropower portfolio. In this role, you will serve as the single point of accountability, bridging cross-functional inputs, and owning the qualification work and the evidence set that makes each facility’s credits defensible.

While you will not be expected to be a tax code expert or a lead design engineer, you must possess enough technical fluency to understand hydropower project lifecycles, track vendor deliverables, interpret high-level IRS compliance requirements, and manage cross-functional timelines and budgets.

Main Responsibilities

Credit Qualification Oversight: Serve as the single point of coordination for tracking and verifying all inputs, documentation, and milestones required to secure ITC/PTC qualifications
Audit & Diligence Readiness: Maintain a clean, contemporaneous qualification file for each facility that withstands tax-preparer, credit-buyer, insurer, and IRS review
Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the central hub for a matrixed team, aligning inputs from supporting departments to support qualification requirements
IRS Compliance Alignment: Work alongside internal tax specialists to interpret high-level IRS requirements and ensure that project workflows capture the necessary evidentiary trail for tax compliance
Vendor & Deliverable Tracking: Monitor external vendor and contractor deliverables specifically tied to tax credit qualification requirements, ensuring reports, studies, and certifications are delivered on schedule
Schedule & Milestone Monitoring: Maintain a master program tracker to monitor critical path qualification milestones, ensuring that project execution timelines managed by the PM team align with tax deadlines and safe-harbor rules
Executive Reporting: Prepare clear, concise executive-level dashboards and status reports summarizing program health, qualification risks, and key decision points for leadership and ownership

Education & Experience Requirements

Required:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Project Management, Business, or a related technical/analytical field
Experience: 3 to 8+ years of professional experience in energy project development, asset management, project controls, or renewable energy finance/tax credit compliance. Hydropower experience is a strong plus
Cross-Functional Fluency: Basic familiarity with energy tax credits (ITC/PTC) and an eagerness to learn IRS regulatory frameworks with the support of internal specialists
Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience may be considered where appropriate

Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate the following competencies:

Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex technical and financial tracking into executive-ready reporting
Project Management: Demonstrated experience managing schedules, budgets, and matrixed or cross-functional team workflows
Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with colleagues, teams, customers, or partners
Problem Solving: Ability to analyze issues, identify solutions, and exercise sound judgment
Organization: Ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, and maintain accurate work
Technical/Functional Expertise: Comfortable reading technical project documentation, engineering reports, and understanding the core components of renewable energy assets (hydro-specific knowledge is highly preferred)
Adaptability: Ability to adjust to changing priorities, processes, or business needs
Accountability: Ability to take ownership of responsibilities and deliver expected results
Customer/Service Orientation: Ability to understand and respond effectively to customer or stakeholder needs

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.

Travel Requirements

This position requires occasional travel (~10%) as part of the job responsibilities if the hire is not located locally in Washington, DC Metro area.

Work Schedule Requirements

The typical work schedule for this position is Monday through Friday. This position is remote/hybrid and may require:

Overtime as needed
Flexibility to adjust working hours based on business needs
The schedule and work hours may be adjusted based on organizational needs and the requirements of the position

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.

Benefits

Eagle Creek offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional development of our employees. Benefits may include:

Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA, Commuter benefits, Voluntary Life, 401(k) match
Competitive holiday & PTO schedule, including time off for community volunteering

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment status, position, length of service, and applicable plan requirements.

jobs.title: Health and Wellness Case Manager
jobs.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten?  Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?

If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.

At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.

If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

ORGANIZATION SUMMARY

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.

Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks a Health and Wellness Case Manager to support vulnerable immigrants in building pathways to physical, emotional, and social well-being. This position provides Intensive Case Management (ICM) for individuals and families, alongside wellness-focused group programming that promotes health education and community integration. Working in a dual-capacity role, the Case Manager guides clients through complex healthcare systems, crafts tailored goal plans for long-term stability and collaborates with health providers and community partners to deliver trauma-informed, fully compliant care.

This is a hybrid role- 4 days in office, 1 work from home.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Client Services and Role Responsibilities

PC Groups & Intensive Case Management

Oversee all incoming Preferred Communities (PC) referrals, conducting comprehensive intake assessments and client enrollments.

Provide direct Intensive Case Management (ICM) to develop and implement targeted, individualized goal plans that foster long-term self-sufficiency.

Maintain regular, proactive communication with clients throughout their service term to monitor progress, address emerging needs, and provide continuous support.

Guide clients through healthcare, social service, and community systems to build their independence and confidence.

Maintain precise, timely documentation and detailed case notes in full alignment with program standards and compliance guidelines

Interdepartmental Collaboration & Wrap-Around Care

Work closely with the Programs Manager and program staff to streamline client service delivery across department lines.

Partner with the Volunteer Coordinator to engage, train, and leverage volunteers or community groups for integrated client support.

Deliver holistic, wrap-around care by connecting clients to wrap-around community services and advocacy networks.

Compliance, Data Management & Quality Assurance:

Assure all compliance measures are strictly maintained across all PC programming and service delivery.

Ensure data collection and outcome tracking are conducted in a timely, accurate, and effective manner for reporting and evaluation.

Administrative Responsibilities

Actively participate in department meetings, staff development opportunities, program trainings, community activities, and organizational events

Submit any requested data to the program manager through monthly, semi-annual, and annual reports.

Maintain accurate and organized files and records of services provided

Ensure continuity of services and reporting during staff transitions and in the absence of a Programs Manager

Adhere to all World Relief policies, including but not limited to, incident reporting procedures, code of conduct, security safety and health

Travel to and between High Point and Winston Salem office locations is a requirement for this position

Perform other tasks and projects as assigned

Note: This job description outlines the primary responsibilities of the role but is not exhaustive; the Case Manager may be assigned additional tasks or duties by the Programs Manager as needed

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Mature and personal Christian faith  

Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief  

Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities  

Able to affirm World Relief’s Core Beliefs and Statement of Faith , and acknowledge World  

Relief’s Christian Identity and National Evangelicals For the Health of The Nation document    

Valid driver’s license, access to reliable vehicle and ability to pass MVR standards 

Experience in case management, health education, or related fields required; experience with refugee or vulnerable populations preferred.   

Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.  

Strong understanding of the challenges faced by refugees and immigrants, including trauma-informed care and cultural sensitivity.  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey information to clients, colleagues, and external partners.  

Strong interpersonal skills, including empathy, active listening, and conflict resolution.  

Fluency in English required. Bilingual in any of the following languages: Arabic, Swahili, Spanish, French, Kareni, Burmese, Pashto, Dari

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Degree in Social Work, Public Health, or similar field.

Cross-cultural experience.

Bilingual in any of the following languages: Arabic, Swahili, Spanish, French, Kareni, Burmese, Pashto, Dari

World Relief offers a competitive benefits package and employee discount program for full-time employees.

World Relief is honored to be recognized with the Gold-level Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation for exceeding the core components of our well-being program including leadership and culture, program foundations and execution, and whole person health.

***

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.

For World Relief staff, strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief is essential, and Christian faith is a prerequisite for employment, based upon United States federal guidelines provided in Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

St. Patrick Center provides opportunities for self-sufficiency and dignity to people who are homeless or at risk of becoming homeless. Individuals and families build permanent, positive change in their lives through safe and affordable housing, sound mental and physical health, and employment and financial stability.

Working collaboratively with individuals, businesses, government and other service providers, St. Patrick Center will end chronic homelessness in the St. Louis region through Housing First, an evidence-based practice that tells us to remove barriers, do intake and assessment early, move people into housing and offer them support to achieve their goals.

Job Summary

Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of St. Louis, St. Patrick Center, is seeking a Case Manager to join the Housing, Employment and Recovery Opportunities (HERO) program. This individual will utilize wrap-around philosophy and techniques to assist clients in transitional housing. The case manager will meet with clients to maintain family and natural supports in the community, collaborate with clients and track the success of the Individual Service Strategy (ISS)/Treatment Plan of Care, coordinate individualized services and the involvement of providers working in the home and community setting and document all support related to activities and services. The core working hours are 8:00am-4:30pm Monday through Friday. This position is located at Freedom Place, an offsite location. Starting Compensation is $45,000.

Job Responsibilities

Visit clients weekly to track ISS goals.
Transport clients to community partner appointments
Contribute to the ideas and processes of the case management team.
Use a peer-to-peer approach to build rapport with individuals in recovery.
Provide emotional and informational support for permanent housing by assessing strengths, desires and immediate and long-term needs of each client.
Develop or contact family and natural supports which exist in the community.
Receive input from case management team members regarding employment, housing, mentoring, substance use, other immediate/long term needs, and long-term financial stability needs.
Complete daily and monthly departmental paperwork
Daily update of electronic files including contact with clients, services or any internal or external referrals made.
Adhere to the strategies and goals outlined in the ISS and Treatment Plan
Coach clients to make solid well-informed decisions which maintain housing and advocate for the client.
Assist client with monthly budgeting.
Complete treatment plans and track goals monthly
Provide financial and money management counseling sessions.
Provide weekly case management sessions to ensure service delivery.
Teach Life Skills classes.
Refer client to additional resources to address other service needs (i.e., legal assistance, VA benefits, community substance use counseling etc.)
Research additional benefits available to enhance service being provided.
Engage the client, the family and natural supports within the community setting when feasible and desired by client.
Networks with federal, state, and local agencies
Any other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree and/or Peer Support Certification required. MSW preferred.
Knowledge of housing and other supportive service resources.
Knowledge of Housing First and Harm Reduction.
Requires driver license (MO residents require Class E), valid and current auto insurance, vehicle.

Various positions will require physical examination, Tuberculosis screening and Hepatitis A. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.

About Lifemoves

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With 40 programs, LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site-based programs and community outreach.

POSITION PURPOSE

LifeMoves provides interim supportive housing for our clients and families. During their stay, clients participate in holistic services tailored to each household’s unique needs and goals. Clients receive support to build self-sufficiency and return to housing stability, including but not limited to accommodations, meals, laundry, case management, and therapy. The team supports clients with housing, employment, benefits, physical and behavioral health through case management, workshops, and connection to specialized resources.

The Case Manager reports to the site Program Director and provides case management, supports daily site operations, maintains a safe and welcoming environment, monitors the site, responds to client needs, and supports client check-ins, group activities, and overall site coordination.

The position plays a key role in supporting people moving toward safe, stable housing and greater self-sufficiency. They provide case management services, life skills support, and resource connections and work in partnership with clients to set goals, celebrate progress, and overcome challenges. Using a trauma-informed and a strength-based approach, this position builds trust and respect, making sure clients feel heard, valued, and supported throughout their journey.

Key responsibilities include supporting clients by connecting them to services, building support networks, facilitating groups and activities, advocating for equitable access, and providing crisis intervention when needed. Beyond working directly with clients, this role may help to improve the overall program by sharing ideas, identifying service gaps, and helping strengthen community relationships. This role maintains clear documentation, contributes to program planning and reporting, and models professional, ethical behavior and works closely with their teammates to provide high-quality, coordinated care. Through their efforts, staff empower clients to grow their strengths, reach their goals, and build a better future.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Client Support and Case Management

Develop and maintain individualized case plans focused on housing, employment, benefits, and overall well-being, based on each client’s strengths and goals.
Support clients with housing searches, employment readiness, benefits enrollment (e.g., General Assistance, CalFresh, CAPI), and skill-building activities such as budgeting and daily living.
Connect clients to healthcare providers and community resources, and assist with coordination, scheduling, and transportation as needed.
Maintain accurate and timely client documentation and outcome tracking in HMIS and the agency’s client management system.
Advocate for client needs and rights when working with partners, landlords, employers, or service agencies; provide mediation and conflict resolution support as needed.
Provide calm, trauma-informed crisis response and ensure all client services align with ethical standards and agency values.

Resource Connection and Community Collaboration

Build and maintain partnerships with community organizations, public agencies, and system partners (e.g., VA, APS, CPS, Probation) to support clients and improve access to resources.
Serve as a liaison between LifeMoves and community stakeholders by sharing information, coordinating services, and promoting trauma-informed care practices.

General Agency Responsibilities

Participate in weekly case conferences, monthly trainings, and regular supervision to strengthen skills.
Fully participate in all required trainings. This includes completing trainings by assigned deadlines, actively engaging during sessions, and applying learnings to daily work.
Attend continuing education opportunities to grow expertise and uphold agency standards.
Be available to work occasional evenings and weekends as needed or as schedule describes.
Perform other duties as assigned to meet program and organizational needs.

Operations And Site Responsibilities

Support daily site operations, including inspections, maintenance coordination, donation management, and general facility upkeep.
Assist with maintaining clean, safe, and organized living environments.
Facilitate group sessions or workshops that promote skill development and confidence.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

Educational Requirements: Associate Degree in related field preferred; or High School Diploma/GED with 2-5 years of equivalent experience in related field. Related fields may include direct involvement in peer advocacy, community outreach, housing services or roles within the homelessness services field..
Technology: Comfortable using basic technology, including phone and messaging systems, email, Microsoft and Google Suites, and databases to complete administrative tasks and case management, reporting, and tracking outcomes.

Service Level Qualifications

Care, Respect, Empathy: Demonstrates empathy, professionalism, and respect for all individuals. Emotional Regulation: Stays calm and supportive in stressful situations and uses de-escalation skills. Documentation: Maintains clear documentation and organization. Organization/Prioritization: Organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.

Care Level Qualifications

Advocacy Skills: Actively advocates for clients in accessing benefits, navigating systems, and ensuring equitable treatment across agencies.
Resource Identification: Able to identify and connect clients to housing, employment, health, and social services by leveraging community resources effectively.
Research Skills: Uses strong analytical skills to research, track, and resolve client needs.
Partnership Engagement: Builds and maintains collaborative relationships with community organizations and service providers through communication and collaboration skills to strengthen client support networks.

COMPETENCIES

Job Knowledge: Understands job duties and performs tasks with accuracy.
Commitment to Growth: Demonstrates a selfless commitment to others on the team, including activity-based dependability, self-improvement activities. Actively seeks opportunities to contribute at higher levels in service to LifeMoves and others on the team.
Performance Improvement: Sets performance goals, establishes the approach, creates a learning environment.
Time Management and Reliability: Manages workload effectively and meets deadlines.
Proactive Collaboration: Actively seeks opportunities to partner with colleagues across teams and functions. Shares knowledge, communicates openly, and anticipates needs to support collective goals. Builds trust by contributing ideas, offering assistance, and ensuring alignment to achieve results together.

Additional Requirements

This position is contingent upon:

Satisfactory results of a background check
Submitting proof of clear TB test results. Results dated within 60 days prior to hire date are acceptable

Supervisory Responsibilities

N/A

Travel Requirements

This role may include small amounts of travel to training and admin events

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this position successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk, hear, and communicate with others in the workplace. The employee must frequently use hands or fingers and handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee must frequently stand, walk, sit, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities this position requires include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

Compensation And Benefits

This rewarding role offers a competitive annual base salary and an opportunity to participate in the LifeMoves benefits package.

LifeMoves is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) committed to building a culturally diverse staff representing the communities we serve. We provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, political affiliation, marital status, physical or mental disability (non-disqualifying), sexual orientation, membership or non-membership in an employee organization, personal favoritism, lived experiences or any other non-merit-based factor. Candidates who are bilingual/bi-cultural, of color, Native/Indigenous, with disabilities, who identify as LGBTQIA+, or who are members of other marginalized groups are strongly encouraged to apply. We aim to create and sustain inclusive, equitable, and welcoming environments where everyone can thrive.

• Ability to manage organized case files for a caseload of 60-90 tenants.

new_jobs.title: SUD Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE:
Substance Use Disorder Case Manager (SUD CM)

REPORTS TO (TITLE):
SUD CM Supervisor

SALARY RANGE:
$32.93 - $41.27 hourly DOE

Job Summary:
Under the supervision of the SUD Case Management Supervisor and the Program Manager of SUD Services at SRTP (both certified Alcohol & Other Drug Services (AODS) counselors), - the SUD CM is responsible for a specifically assigned caseload of patients and supporting the progress and treatment retention for all SUD/MAT patients generally by providing direct and indirect patient care utilizing individualized treatment planning, psychosocial education and patient support that reflects SUD services which are integrated with primary medical care in an Integrated Care Setting. As a member of the MAT Team (which includes MAT leadership, medical assistants, case managers, and licensed mental health and medical providers), s/he participates in the case management of SUD/MAT patients who may need complex care coordination across multiple life domains and disciplines (medical, dental, mental health, hospital in-patient, and ER visits). The SUD Case Manager also participates in quality improvement activities for numerous health measures related to progress, stability, engagement, and integration with medical and mental health care services. The SUD Case Manager must also carefully collect, organize, and provide SUD Services leadership with data necessary to support development, implementation, grant applications and reports, and quality review and improvement efforts.

Specific Tasks/Duties Include
:

In collaboration with AODS certified counselors, the patient, mental health, and medical providers, assists with meeting the needs of SUD/MAT patients, including participation in 1:1 medically supervised office visits (SUD CM collect meets with patient after the MA and before the provider to obtain current information from the patient, SUD CM then prepares the chart for the provider), warm handoffs, conducting detailed SUD assessments and drafting the related narrative reports, creating and updating thorough treatment plans, education, care coordination, follow-up care, and outside referrals. This work takes place in face-to-face visits, phone meetings, virtual sessions, shared medical visits, and in the Electronic Health Record, and media
With patients, review all intake documents for thoroughness and accuracy, enter data and scan relevant documents for review in the EHR
Administers alcohol, drug, socio-economic, anxiety and depression screening tools
Track and support patient engagement in SUD/MAT care, mental health, and primary care services; use motivational interviewing and shared decision making to identify barriers, strengths and needs to address failure to fully participate in treatment, support prioritizing treatment participation in the face of challenging life circumstances. Seeks to engage patient in a warm and empathic manner, using personal reminder calls and check-ins, and assistance with community transportation when possible.
Utilizing patient-centered treatment planning, creates and tracks appropriate referrals both in house and within the community
Updates primary IBH/MH and medical providers with documented, brief summary of patient progress as needed
Regularly review and report UTOX results to the medical team for interpretation
Communicate effectively in both written and oral form with medical, dental, and mental health clinicians regarding patient SUD history, treatment planning and patient progress
Using Electronic Health Records, document patient schedules, communications, progress notes, detailed assessments and narrative reports, and patient facing documentation
Participate in the schedule to carry the mobile phone which allows patients access to SUD/MAT CM support after hours
Participate in weekly meetings, including case conference, with MAT Team members, IBH Team, and Campus specific leadership
In twice monthly meetings, work in close partnership with a licensed MH clinician as a care team partner to support the needs SUD/MAT/IBH patients
With medical providers, co-facilitate shared medical visits, support group engagement with shared content when indicated to facilitate SMART goal setting. Coordinate with in-house and community pharmacies to ensure workflow efficacy and patient engagement
Maintain strict adherence to confidentiality laws regarding patient and medical records
At the request of SRCH leadership, may represent integrated SUD/MAT services in the community and to partnering agencies (SRTP, CenterPoint/DAAC, WRS, Athena House, MADF, Juvenile Hall, Drug Court, Department of Probation, etc.)
May offer in-person, direct support services to patients who are in custody at the Sonoma County MADF and Juvenile Hall
Via direct phone contact, act as liaison to local hospitals/ERs to make follow-up appointments for and with patients
Maintain expertise on subject matter by staying current with required CEUs and educational requirements, rehabilitation tools and information related to substance use disorder, recovery, and MAT for OUD and AUD
Review jail, court, hospital, ED, inpatient, and crisis stabilization unit reports regarding SUD/MAT patients
Prepare and then participate in clinical team huddles to provide contextual patient information to medical and mental health providers such as UTOX results, drug use history, current strengths, and stressors
Will provide services at multiple SRCH Campus locations
Participate in ongoing training
Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
:

Education:

AA degree (Bachelor’s degree preferred) or two years of work experience in a social/human service setting
Current certification as an AODS counselor through an organization accredited by the State of California or registration as an AODS counselor intern with capability to complete AODS counselor certification within two years

Experience:

Experience with AODS services and/or principles of harm reduction model preferred
Experience with MAT preferred
Experience with Motivational Interviewing preferred
Experience working in a medical environment preferred

Knowledge and Skills:

Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred
Excellent collaboration and team building skills
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
Must demonstrate understanding of the various models of addiction and recovery, active listening skills, trauma informed care, and motivational interviewing
Understanding of ACEs, PREPARE (social determinants of health), and mindfulness skills preferred
Ability to build community relationships with outside agencies
Excellent interpersonal skills; sensitivity and experience working with people from a wide range of backgrounds, lifestyles, and family compositions
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize projects, work relatively independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines
Excellent collaboration and team-building skills
Good judgment, problem solving, and decision-making skills
Demonstrate and practices professional ethics and clear personal boundaries
Demonstrate knowledge of compliance issues within the community clinic environment
Demonstrate a willingness to report any incident that is unusual or incompatible with accepted clinic procedures
Fundamental understanding and strict regard for laws related to patient confidentiality
Must have access to insured transportation, a valid California driver’s license, and a good driving record.

SRCH is an equal opportunity employer to all, regardless of age, ancestry, color, disability (mental and physical), exercising the right to family care and medical leave, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, political affiliation, race, religious creed, sex (includes pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), and sexual orientation.

Physical Requirements
:

While performing the duties of this job, this position is frequently required to do the following:

Use standard office equipment and access, input, and retrieve information from a computer.
Use computer keyboard with manual and finger dexterity and wrist-finger speed sufficient to perform repetitive actions efficiently for extended periods of time.
Perform complex mental functions; collect, interpret, and/or analyze complex data and information.
Vision: see details of objects at close range.
Reach forward, up, down, and to the side.
Sit or stand for minimum periods of one hour at a time and come and go from the work area repeatedly throughout the day.
Lift up to 20 pounds.
Travel to other office and community locations, such as local hospitals.

SRCH provides reasonable accommodation for individuals with a physical or mental disability to apply for jobs and to perform the essential functions of their jobs unless it would cause an undue hardship

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Core Autonomy
new_jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own performance and release for the autonomy stack that runs across our L2+ passenger vehicle, L4 truck, and mining vehicle programs.

You'll sit at the center of the stack's engineering leadership, turning system health into release decisions, and coordinating those releases across every downstream team building on top of it.

At Applied Intuition, You Will

Performance measurement: Define and own how we measure and forecast the stack's reliability, so leadership knows not just where we stand today but where we're headed.
Release ownership: Drive the stack's release cycle end to end - coordinate how the Core team ship to multiple vertical projects, and manage expectations with downstream teams.
Prioritization: Identify the key projects to improve the driving performance with engineering leads, and unblock the execution
Reporting: Build the reporting that gives engineering and customer-facing teams a clear, shared view of performance and release status.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Background in autonomy, robotics, or ML
3+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, or a related field
The ability to context switch effectively across multiple projects
Willing to operate without a fixed lane - making the product call one day, running the analysis or building the dashboard the next

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. Key Responsibilities

Senior Program Manager - Talent Acquisition Programs

We are seeking an experienced Senior PX Program Manager to lead the delivery, optimization, adoption, and continuous improvement of strategic Talent Acquisition (TA) programs and priority People Experience (PX) initiatives. This role combines program management, recruiting operations, process optimization, and change management to strengthen how the organization attracts, assesses, selects, and hires talent.

This is a full-time role responsible for advancing critical TA and PX priorities, strengthening operating rigor, and developing efficient, repeatable approaches that support organizational growth.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition Program Delivery

Lead the planning, coordination, execution, and launch of complex TA programs and cross-functional PX initiatives, such as recruiting process optimization, interviewer enablement, hiring capacity planning, candidate experience, recruiting technology implementations, and talent-program rollouts.
Partner with TA and PX leaders to define program scope, objectives, milestones, timelines, risks, dependencies, resources, and success measures.
Translate strategic hiring priorities into actionable roadmaps, workstreams, implementation plans, and sustainable operating models.
Maintain integrated program plans and operating rhythms; monitor progress and proactively manage risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
Drive alignment and accountability across recruiters, coordinators, sourcers, hiring managers, interviewers, systems teams, and other partners to achieve milestones and intended outcomes.
Ensure programs transition effectively from implementation to sustainable business-as-usual operations with clear ownership, documentation, and performance measures.

Recruiting Process Optimization and Operational Excellence

Lead end-to-end assessment and optimization of priority TA processes, including workforce demand intake, requisition launch, sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offer management, preboarding, and recruiting operations.
Map current-state processes and design future-state workflows that improve speed, quality, consistency, compliance, candidate experience, hiring-manager experience, and operational effectiveness.
Identify process gaps, bottlenecks, redundancies, manual work, inconsistent practices, and unclear ownership; determine root causes and develop practical, scalable solutions.
Partner with TA leaders and subject-matter experts to clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, service expectations, escalation paths, and operating mechanisms.
Develop and implement standardized playbooks, SOPs, templates, toolkits, and governance practices that enable consistent execution across recruiting teams and hiring stakeholders.

Embed continuous improvement practices into TA programs and processes using operational data, stakeholder feedback, candidate insights, and lessons learned.

Change Management and Adoption

Develop and execute change management strategies that support successful adoption and long-term sustainability of new TA programs, systems, tools, and processes.
Assess stakeholder impacts and organizational readiness, then create communication, engagement, training, enablement, and reinforcement plans.
Partner with TA leaders, recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and subject-matter experts to facilitate change and minimize disruption.
Track adoption, stakeholder readiness, and effectiveness; use findings to adjust implementation plans and improve future initiatives.
Ensure redesigned processes are supported by clear documentation, training materials, communications, ownership, and reinforcement mechanisms.

Stakeholder Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration

Build trusted relationships across Talent Acquisition, PX, Finance, Legal, IT, business leadership, and hiring teams.
Facilitate stakeholder alignment, decision-making, process design, and issue resolution across multiple workstreams.
Lead working sessions to identify root causes, evaluate options and tradeoffs, and align stakeholders on practical solutions.

Escalate risks, tradeoffs, and decisions appropriately and provide clear recommendations that enable timely resolution.

Governance, Analytics, and Operating Effectiveness

Use quantitative and qualitative data to identify opportunities, inform recommendations, measure outcomes, and support ongoing improvement.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP-PHP)
new_jobs.description:
The Program Manager, Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP-PHP)
leads a program designed to meet young adults at one of the most pivotal and vulnerable transitions of their lives. Ages 18 to 26 bring new independence, new responsibilities, and often new or intensified mental health challenges without the safety net of adolescence. This developmental window also coincides with the peak age of onset for many mental health conditions, making early, intensive intervention especially critical. Casa de Amparo's Program Manager oversees the Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP), ensuring the program's operations, staffing, and clinical standards are equipped to provide the stability young adults need to navigate this transition successfully. The position oversees treatment planning, documentation, utilization management, and billing productivity while ensuring compliance with governing agencies and Joint Commission accreditation standards and providing leadership and support to program staff. The Manager may provide direct clinical services and supervision, depending on qualifications and program need.

Treatment/Supervision:

Supervise program staff, assuring collaboration with the County, external service providers, community partners, and internal Casa de Amparo departments.
Oversee development and implementation of assessments, problem lists, treatment and care plans, transition of care plans, discharge plans, and other required documentation.
Ensure medically necessary specialty mental health services are provided in accordance with client needs, scope of practice, contract requirements, and applicable regulations.
Oversee the provision of IOP/PHP services including assessment, plan development, collateral, individual/group/family therapy, rehabilitation, crisis intervention, case management, peer support and/or recovery services, skill building groups, process groups, adjunctive therapies, psychotherapy, group treatment, and structured milieu programming.
Develop staff schedules, group schedules, training schedules, treatment services schedules, and other schedules necessary for operating the IOP/PHP program.
Assure clinical support and presence during treatment hours in accordance with client needs, regulations, staffing ratios, and contract requirements.
Coordinate with the Chief Programs Officer to monitor the provision of psychiatric assessment and psychiatric contacts in collaboration with the Consulting Psychiatrist and program staff.
Oversee and/or provide clinical supervision to licensed providers, registered licensed-eligible providers, clinical trainees, or other clinical staff as needed and dependent on qualifications.
Ensure that care is provided by staff that is knowledgeable and respectful of differing cultures and the norms that exist within various cultures.
Provide direct clinical services with a small clinical caseload as needed.

Administrative:

Serve as the primary program contact and single point of contact for County correspondence, including timely response to emails, telephone calls, and other correspondence.
Notify the County and Chief Programs Officer of planned absences from the program and assure alternate program coverage as required.
Assure treatment services meet all contract, Medi-Cal, accreditation, documentation, and regulatory requirements in coordination with the Chief Programs Officer, Quality Assurance, and other leadership staff.
Coordinate with Quality Assurance staff to conduct chart audits, monitor documentation quality, and follow up with staff for chart and billing completion.
Manage program productivity, appropriateness of services, authorization needs, and billing readiness in coordination with leadership and administrative support staff.
Complete County requested summaries, reports, data reviews, staffing updates, and other program documentation as assigned.
Facilitate Treatment Team meetings and other program meetings to review client progress, service needs, risk, transitions, and discharge planning.
Assure staff participation in required in-service trainings and maintain awareness of required training logs in collaboration with Training and Staff Development Manager.
Review program statistical reports and client outcomes and discuss with the Quality Assurance Team and Clinical Team as appropriate to improve service delivery.
Adhere to and assure staff compliance with Casa de Amparo’s Code of Ethics, Policies & Procedures, Employee Handbook, and all applicable program requirements.
Perform other relevant duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Must be able to be associated with Casa de Amparo through Community Care Licensing (CCL), if applicable to the program/site, which typically includes clearance by FBI, DOJ and CACI.
Master’s degree from an accredited college or university required.
Must be a California licensed mental health professional with a minimum of three (3) years, full-time direct clinical experience post Master’s degree working with adults. Any exceptions are contingent upon County Contracting Officer Representative (COR) approval.
Two years post licensure in order to provide clinical supervision preferred.
Previous experience with Medi-Cal, Specialty Mental Health Services, County behavioral health contracts, utilization management, billing requirements, and electronic health records required.
Two years management experience preferred.
Knowledge of IOP/PHP services, day treatment intensive services, therapeutic milieu programming, crisis intervention, co-occurring treatment, trauma-informed care, recovery-oriented services, and community-based behavioral health care preferred.
Knowledge of adults with serious mental health needs, including adults stepping down from acute care or at risk of requiring higher levels of care.
Must possess strong interpersonal, time-management, organizational, written/verbal communication skills, and intermediate computer literacy. English proficient/Bilingual Spanish preferred.
Must have ambulatory, auditory, and visual skills to observe clients and staff.
Must have the physical ability to participate in activities and perform related physical skills, including, but not limited to, crouching, lifting 50 pounds, crawling on hands and knees, and walking up and down stairs.
Ability to comply with all employment requirements including, but not limited to CPR/First Aid, physical, TB and drug screen clearance, clear DMV record and approval from insurance carrier to drive agency vehicles. Must provide proof of immunization against influenza, pertussis, and measles.
Must be at least 21 years of age.

new_jobs.title: Principal Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

We’re looking for an experienced Principal Program Manager
to join our Client Engagement team.

In this role, you’ll help turn complex client priorities into clear, executable programs across Client Engagement, Product, Engineering, and client stakeholders. You’ll own the operating rhythm for high-stakes client initiatives, from kickoff and scoping through launch, adoption, and long-term success.

This is a role for someone who can bring structure to ambiguity, keep cross-functional work moving, and build trust with both internal teams and enterprise customers.

P&C insurance industry experience is a strong plus, but not required. What matters most is the ability to learn the domain quickly and build credibility with enterprise clients.

Some of the Work You’ll Own:

🔗 Turn client needs into clear execution plans.

Sit between Product, Engineering, and client stakeholders to translate client priorities into scoped initiatives, owners, timelines, risks, and next steps.

🚀 Drive high-stakes carrier initiatives from kickoff to launch.

Own the operating plan for client-facing projects, including dependencies, decision points, launch readiness, stakeholder alignment, and the many details that determine whether a rollout feels controlled or chaotic.

📋 Build the Client Engagement operating muscle.

Create the intake, tracking, status, and escalation rhythms that help Client Engagement manage carrier work consistently as Assured scales.

🧭 Make risks and tradeoffs visible early.

When timelines shift, scope expands, or dependencies get stuck, surface the issue clearly, frame the options, and help the right people make the right call before it becomes a client-facing fire drill.

🗣️ Be the translator across clients and internal teams.

Turn carrier feedback, asks, and concerns into clear internal action. Turn Product and Engineering constraints into client-ready explanations that build confidence instead of confusion.

🔍 Find patterns across client work.

Notice when multiple carriers are asking for the same thing, running into the same friction, or needing the same support, and help turn those patterns into better processes, product improvements, or scalable client programs.

⏱️ Keep multiple concurrent initiatives balanced and honest.

Manage the mechanics that keep complex work moving, including RAID logs, dependency mapping, launch plans, follow-ups, status reporting, and critical path management, without adding process for process’s sake.

How You'll Make an Impact:

🎯 Improve confidence in client delivery.

Help Assured give enterprise clients clearer visibility, tighter execution, and more predictable launches across complex initiatives. You’ll build trust by being organized, precise, and honest about what is known, unknown, and changing.

🔍 Keep everyone aligned without meeting overload.

Build clear status updates, trackers, launch plans, and decision logs so leadership, Client Engagement, Product, Engineering, and client stakeholders can understand where things stand without needing another meeting just to find the answer.

⚡ Use AI to move faster.

Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and similar platforms to draft project plans, synthesize client feedback, maintain documentation, identify risks, and keep work moving without letting coordination consume the week.

📈 Help scale Client Engagement.

As Assured grows, Client Engagement needs better systems for managing client commitments, launches, escalations, and cross-functional work. You’ll help build the operating model that lets the team scale without losing the high-touch client experience.

You'll Probably Thrive Here If You:

🏗️ Have deep program management experience.

You’ve led complex, cross-functional work with real stakeholder pressure, shifting timelines, ambiguous requirements, and external customers in the mix. You know how to create structure, drive alignment, and keep teams moving when the path is not perfectly defined.

💬 Are client-facing and internally rigorous.

You can communicate clearly with client stakeholders, then turn around and drive internal follow-through with the right level of detail.

🛠️ Are comfortable being technical-adjacent.

You don’t need to write code, but you need to understand product and engineering constraints well enough to ask good questions, scope honestly, and avoid hand-wavy commitments.

🧭 Can operate without waiting for perfect clarity.

You know how to create structure when the path is still forming. You can identify what matters, what’s blocked, who owns what, and what decision needs to happen next.

⚖️ Balance urgency with discipline.

You move quickly, but you don’t skip the basics: owners, dates, risks, dependencies, decisions, and follow-up.

🗣️ Lead through influence.

You know how to get people moving together by being clear, trusted, and relentlessly organized.

🔄 Learn the domain fast.

Prior insurance experience is helpful, but curiosity and speed of learning matter more. You should be able to quickly understand claims workflows, carrier operations, product behavior, and the client context behind each request.

Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

Medical case management is a collaborative process that involves the assessment, planning, coordination, and monitoring of health care services for individuals with complex medical needs. The goal of medical case management is to optimize the health and well-being of individuals by ensuring they receive appropriate and timely medical care, support services, and resources.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

This position reports to the Manager of HIV Medical Case Management. This position does not supervise any other position.

Essential Job Duties And Functions

While living and demonstrating our Core Values, the Ryan White Medical Case Manager
will:

Conduct thorough assessments of clients' medical, psychosocial, and financial situations to understand their individual needs.
Conduct intake assessments, reassessments, recertifications, budgets, acuity scales, and all other relevant case management documentation.
Develop individualized care plans, also called service coordination plans, based on assessment findings, outlining specific health care goals, interventions, and strategies.
Collaborate with health care providers, specialists, and other professionals to coordinate and facilitate access to medical care, including antiretroviral treatment and other necessary health care services.
Support clients in adhering to prescribed medical treatments and medications, providing education on the importance of treatment adherence.
Assist clients in navigating the health care system and accessing available resources, including, but not limited to, financial assistance, housing support, and transportation services.

Collaborate with health care professionals, social service agencies, and community organizations to ensure a coordinated and holistic approach to client care.

Participate in quality management initiatives to address identified needs for the overall program.

Enter all notes within five business days or by the third business day of the following month, whichever comes first.
Maintain a list of organizations that referrals can be made to the client.

Demonstrate flexibility when responding to change
Demonstrate professionalism to other staff members.

Job Description

The Ward Law Group is seeking a bilingual Case Manager to support clients through the early stages of their personal injury cases. new_jobs.title: Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Tollinchi Law, P.A.
, we believe a personal injury client deserves more than a lawyer, they deserve a team that listens, communicates, takes ownership, and fights to make a difficult situation better.

Our mission is simple: turning client setbacks into comebacks.

We are a South Florida law firm focused on Personal Injury, our approach is rooted in compassionate client care, legal excellence, and a commitment to making a meaningful difference in the lives of the people we serve.

We are looking for a Personal Injury Case Manager
who understands that managing a case is about much more than checking boxes and requesting records.
It's about knowing the story behind the case, understanding what is happening with the client, identifying what is missing, anticipating what comes next, and making sure nothing or no one falls through the cracks.

THE ROLE

As a Case Manager , you will take ownership of a personal injury caseload from intake through the demand phase, working closely with attorneys, clients, medical providers, insurance carriers, and the rest of our team.
You will be responsible for keeping cases moving, maintaining accurate and complete files, identifying potential issues early, and ensuring our attorneys have the information they need to evaluate and resolve each case effectively.
This is a high accountability, highly organized remote position
for someone who can work independently while remaining deeply connected to the team.
You will be expected to manage the details without losing sight of the person behind the file.

THE OWNERSHIP

Client Experience & Communication

Serve as a consistent point of contact for clients throughout the pre-litigation process.
Build trusting relationships with clients through proactive , compassionate, and professional communication.
Conduct client interviews and obtain the information necessary to understand the full scope of the client's injuries, treatment, losses, and circumstances.
Keep clients informed about case progress, anticipated next steps, and outstanding items.
Identify new or ongoing issues, changes in treatment, additional damages, or concerns that may affect the case.
Communicate with clients by telephone, email, and other approved firm communication platforms.

Case Management & Case Development

Manage personal injury cases from intake through the demand phase.
Monitor each case for progress, deadlines, milestones, and outstanding tasks.
Review cases regularly to determine what needs to happen next and ensure those items are assigned and completed.
Gather, organize, and analyze medical records, bills, police reports, insurance information, and other evidence necessary to develop the case.
Follow up consistently with medical providers, insurance carriers, clients, and other third parties.
Monitor medical treatment and identify gaps, delays, or issues requiring attention.
Research and investigate information relevant to liability, injuries, treatment, damages, and potential case value.
Identify missing information and proactively pursue it rather than waiting for someone else to discover the gap.
Prepare comprehensive demand packages and supporting documentation under attorney direction.
Assist attorneys in preparing matters for settlement negotiations.
Maintain accurate, organized, and current case files and documentation within the firm's case management system.

Case Flow Ownership & Accountability

Participate in weekly case review meetings with the team.
Identify cases that are stalled, approaching deadlines, missing documentation, or requiring escalation.
Ensure tasks have clear ownership and due dates and follow through until completion.
Review case management activity for quality, timeliness, and completeness.
Audit files to ensure compliance with firm standards and established workflows.
Communicate patterns, exceptions, quality concerns, and training needs to the Pre-Litigation Supervisor.
Analyze case progress, turnaround times, client responsiveness, and other relevant case-management metrics.
Participate in monthly case reviews and help identify opportunities to improve workflows and procedures.
Support the development and refinement of Standard Operating Procedures as the firm continues to grow.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

At Tollinchi Law
, success in this role isn't simply measured by how many files you touch.
A successful Case Manager:
Owns the file.

You don't wait for someone else to tell you what needs to happen next.
Knows the client.

You understand the person behind the case, not just the matter number in the system.
Sees the bigger picture.

You ask questions, recognize patterns, and understand how treatment, liability, documentation, and damages come together.
Moves cases forward.

You recognize when something is stalled and take action.
Communicates before you're asked.

You keep clients, attorneys, and teammates informed rather than allowing surprises to happen.
Protects the details.

You understand that accurate records, timely follow-up, and complete documentation matter.
Takes ownership.

When something falls through the cracks, you don't look for someone to blame, you look for a solution.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

Experience managing personal injury cases in a plaintiff-side law firm environment.
Strong understanding of pre-litigation personal injury case management.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, priorities, and competing demands.
Ability to work independently and maintain productivity in a remote environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to exercise sound judgment and identify when an issue requires escalation.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and case management technology.
Ability to learn and follow established systems, procedures, and workflows.

Preferred

2+ years of personal injury case management or related plaintiff-side legal experience.
Prior paralegal or legal assistant experience.
Experience with automobile insurance claims and PIP.
Experience preparing personal injury demand packages.
Experience communicating with insurance carriers, medical providers, lienholders, and clients.
Familiarity with case management systems such as Smokeball, Clio, or similar platforms.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.
Bilingual in Spanish or Haitian Creole.

THIS ROLE MAY BE A GREAT FIT FOR YOU IF...

You genuinely care about what happens to the people you serve.
You are naturally organized and don't need someone constantly checking behind you.
You enjoy having ownership over your work.
You are comfortable managing a high-volume, deadline-driven caseload.
You are curious and ask the extra question when something doesn't make sense.
You notice when information is missing.
You don't need to be reminded to follow up.
You communicate clearly and professionally.
You can work remotely without becoming disconnected from your team.
You want to grow with a firm that values accountability, teamwork, client experience, and continuous improvement.

WHY TOLLINCHI LAW?

We believe the way we treat our clients matters just as much as the legal work we perform.
Our clients are not case numbers. They are people who have experienced something that disrupted their lives, and they trust us to help them navigate what comes next.

We are building a team that believes in:
Client First.

Own It.

Failure Is Not an Option.

Work-Life Balance.

Community Champion.

If you want to be part of a firm where your work has a direct impact on clients, where accountability matters, and where you have the opportunity to grow alongside a growing team, we would love to hear from you.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Competitive salary based on experience
Performance-based bonus opportunities
Paid time off
Firm holidays
Dark week(s)
Fully remote position
Supportive team environment
Opportunities for professional growth

READY TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE?

If you are an experienced personal injury Case Manager who is ready to take ownership of your cases, advocate for your clients, and help turn setbacks into comebacks, we want to meet you.

Apply today and tell us why you would be a great addition to the Tollinchi Law team.

Email your resume to Amy@Tollinchilaw.com and tell us your favorite movie and the reason why it is your favorite movie. Be sure to put “Greatest Legal Warrior” in the subject line.
